subject.title: [Bug]: codex agent fails ("exited with code 1") — macOS XProtect deletes bundled @openai/codex@0.128.0 as malware; codex-acp@0.0.44 pins the flagged version

question: Should acpx fix this Codex startup failure by only bumping the owned Codex adapter pin, or by also adding an automatic `CODEX_PATH` fallback to a system Codex binary?
rationale: Both fixes are plausible, but the adapter jump is compatibility-sensitive and automatic system-binary fallback changes the built-in launcher contract that this repository treats as product surface.

options.title: Bump adapter and document workaround
options.body: Move the Codex adapter off `^0.0.44`, compatibility-test initialize/session/model behavior, and document `CODEX_PATH` for explicit manual recovery.

options.title: Bump plus guarded fallback
options.body: Do the adapter bump and add a Codex-only fallback that sets `CODEX_PATH` from the child `PATH` when unset, preserving explicit `CODEX_PATH` precedence and testing both paths.

options.title: Diagnostics and docs only
options.body: Keep the adapter pin for now while improving the opaque startup error and documenting manual `CODEX_PATH`, accepting that users without a system override remain exposed.

recommendation.title: Bump plus guarded fallback
recommendation.body: Do the adapter bump and add a Codex-only fallback that sets `CODEX_PATH` from the child `PATH` when unset, preserving explicit `CODEX_PATH` precedence and testing both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the Codex adapter switch and is tied to the built-in launch ownership path affected by either repair option.
